steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each day is placed in the week, with its volume and backlog.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 daily figure does not match its rows

findings.title: Figure does not match its source rows
findings.fix: Recompute the figure from the rows

findings.title: Day missing from the dashboard
findings.fix: Add the day from the export

findings.title: Change above 25 percent with no note
findings.fix: Explain the change in one line

outcome.notChecked: Work that is not recorded in the export.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks a measure that does not match its source rows, a day missing, and a change above 25 percent with no note.
cons: Not checked: Work that is not recorded in the export.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-daily-dashboard skill on the records for this review.
